framing.lineOfInquiry: Harpreet Gill (P00137) may have been involved in the incident recorded in CASE036
framing.alternate: Harpreet Gill (P00137) was not involved — the evidence has an innocent explanation
framing.note: KRONOS starts from the presumption of innocence. The line of inquiry and the alternates are tested against the same records; neither is a finding, and the strengths are not probabilities.

alternateHypotheses.title: Was elsewhere at the time (alibi)
alternateHypotheses.statement: Harpreet Gill was somewhere else when the incident happened.
alternateHypotheses.label: Strong

evidence.text: Recorded at Sector 5 Market, Panchkula, 232.1 km from the scene, 135 min after the incident — could not have reached the scene by road in that time

alternateHypotheses.test: Verify the alibi record independently (CCTV, witnesses or receipts at that place and time) and check whether the device could have been carried by someone else.

alternateHypotheses.title: Named or given a role in error
alternateHypotheses.statement: Harpreet Gill was named in the FIR, or assigned a role, without an independent basis.
alternateHypotheses.label: Moderate

evidence.text: FIR text contains: '…no role has been attributed…'

alternateHypotheses.test: Re-examine the FIR and statements; record the person's statement and the informant's basis for naming them.

alternateHypotheses.title: The money has a legitimate explanation
alternateHypotheses.statement: The flagged money movements of Harpreet Gill have an ordinary purpose (salary, rent, property, business) or belong to a co-holder of the account.
alternateHypotheses.label: Moderate

evidence.text: Flagged NEFT ₹555,000 on 2025-05-27 14:48 has a stated purpose 'consultancy fee'

alternateHypotheses.test: Obtain full statements, invoices or agreements and KYC; confirm the stated purpose with the counter-party.

alternateHypotheses.title: The contact was routine, not coordination
alternateHypotheses.statement: Harpreet Gill's calls and messages reflect a long-standing relationship (family, work, business), not planning of the incident.
alternateHypotheses.label: Weak

evidence.text: In contact with Neha Kapoor since 2025-04-27, 29 days before the incident (7 calls, 4 messages) — a long-standing relationship
In contact with Ajay Thakur since 2025-04-29, 27 days before the incident (16 calls, 16 messages) — a long-standing relationship
In contact with Lakhwinder Khan since 2025-05-03, 24 days before the incident (7 calls, 5 messages) — a long-standing relationship

alternateHypotheses.test: Examine message content and the timing of contact relative to the incident; establish the relationship.

alternatesConsideredNotSupported.title: Was near the scene for a routine reason
Someone else used the phone or handset

comparison.verdict: The alibi alternate (A1) is currently better supported than the line of inquiry: records place Harpreet Gill elsewhere and none place them at the scene.
